Tucson, Arizona · stay

Hotels in Tucson for cyclists

Places to stay in Tucson when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the start, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: El Tour de Tucson.

Hotels in Tucson for cyclists, listed

  1. DoubleTree by Hilton Tucson Downtown Convention Center

    $$$ · 280 S Church Ave, Tucson, AZ 85701

    Directly beside the Tucson Convention Center, where El Tour starts and packets are picked up; pool and lobby bar

  2. The Leo Kent Hotel

    $$$ · 1 S Church Ave, Tucson, AZ 85701

    Upscale boutique hotel a few blocks north of the convention center, with a restaurant and gym

  3. AC Hotel by Marriott Tucson Downtown

    $$$ · 151 E Broadway Blvd, Tucson, AZ 85701

    Modern downtown hotel at Fifth and Congress, walkable to the start and the streetcar

  4. Hotel Congress

    $$ · 311 E Congress St, Tucson, AZ 85701

    Historic downtown hotel with the Cup Cafe downstairs; lively, not quiet, and a short walk to the start

  5. Hotel McCoy

    $$ · 720 W Silverlake Rd, Tucson, AZ 85713

    Retro motor lodge south of downtown with free breakfast, a heated saltwater pool and room-front parking for loading bikes
